lA NO: 1 OF 2025  Petition under Section 151 CPC is filed praying that in  circumstances stated in the affidavit filed in support of the petition, the High Court may be pleased to direct the respondents No. 2 to 6 not to disposes petitioner from the land in an extant of an Ac.3.33 cents in Sy.No.63/1 in Kennamakulapalle village, ShanthipuramMandal, Chittoor District, without acquisition of the same under the provision of Rehabilitation and Resettlement (Andhra Pradesh Amendment) Act, 2013, and payment of compensation,
Pending disposal of WP 28865 of 2025, on the file of the High Courts'
 The petition coming on for hearing, upon perusing the Petition and the affidavit filed in support thereof and the order of the High Court dated 17.10.2025 made herein and upon hearing the arguments of M/s S.Parineeta Advobate for the Petitioner, GP for Revenue for the Respondent Nos.1 to 4,
Sri M.Sudhir, Standing Counsel for respondent No.6, the Court made the following;
 ORDER:
The Writ Petition is filed seeking to declare the action of respondents in interfering with the land of the petitioner in an extent of ac.3.33 cents in Sy.No.63/1 in Kennamakulapalle Village, Santhipuram Mandal, Chittoor District for construction of bus stand without initiating any land acquisition proceedings, as void and illegal.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has relied on the observations made by the Junior Civil Judge,
Kuppam in O.S.No.245 of 1999 wherein the petitioner who is the plaintiff in the said suit have filed a suit against the respondent-State as well as APSRTC.

Considering the merits of the case, the Court has passed a decree declaring the plaintiffs 1 to 4 and 6 to 9 rights and title to items 1 to 6 of the plaint schedule property is declared and consequently granted permanent injunction restraining the defendants, their men and subordinates from in any manner interfering with the plaintiffs peaceful possession and enjoyment of the suit schedule sites by making any constructions.

sentences.text: Contrary to the said decree, now the respondents are trying to establish a bus stand without acquiring said land as per the provisions of the Act 2013.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader, on instructions has submitted that they are only conducting physical verification of the land suitable for establishment of bus stand and they do not violate the principles of natural justice.

Considering the said submissions, there shall be a direction to the respondents not to dispossess and interfere with the possessionof the petitioner over the subject property, without following due process of law.
List after four (04) weeks for filing counter-affidavit.
